Exited at the next frame when the leg violently whipsawed (+46.5 -> -5.75), giveback jumped to 44%, and PROPP flipped to join KMDR+CLIMAX all-against -- three concordant against-fires plus price crossing back to unfavorable was the confirmed-reversal signature.
